Event: Calworth offsite.
Date: Monday.
Schedule: Morning stand-up in garden studio. Afternoon in print room. Evening in harbour room.
Room Preferences/Constraints: Ada prefers library annex for reviews. Wren prefers print room for reviews. Una thinks print room too cold evening; Kira thinks harbour room too cold evening. Opal, Una, Hugo, and Cora want print room, loading bay, library annex, and print room kept clear for visitors respectively. Dell wants harbour room kept clear.
Repainting Noise: Garden studio (afternoon), Loading bay (afternoon), Print room (morning and evening), East wing (morning).
Facilities/Notes: Umbrella in garden studio. North office free afternoon; coffee working. Lift near north office slow. Lift near east wing slow. East wing coffee working. Esme asked about garden studio afternoon availability. Jonah asked if harbour room is free afternoon.
Personnel: Una, Opal, Bram (out; Rafe covering), Wren (covering for Suri; swapping with Teo; thinks loading bay cold afternoon), Kira, Nils (swapping with Una), Mira, Esme, Jonah, Teo (covering for Leon; swapping with Wren), Leon (out), Suri (out rest of week).
Tasks: Send Opal morning meeting notes. Send Dell afternoon meeting notes. Send Una afternoon meeting notes.
